label: Read-Only Admin (Server RBAC role)
type: a Server RBAC role granting read-only access to cluster state. One of the three roles authorization-overview.md lists as available in Community Edition. Split in 8.0: the security-settings half moved to Read-Only Security Admin.
note: Promoted with role:bucket-full-access from authorization-overview.md's Community Edition list. Its 8.0 split is one of three independent role splits (with Local User Security Admin and External User Security Admin) that all decompose the same distinction - separating 'can manage or view security settings' from 'can manage or view other cluster state'. That consistency across three unrelated pre-8.0 roles is evidence of one deliberate 8.0 security-hardening initiative, a fact no single role's own section states.
